summary: Planet Labs PBC filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its redemption of public warrants originally issued in its IPO. The redemption occurred on April 27, 2026, at a redemption price of $0.01 per warrant. Of the 9,162,223 outstanding warrants, 99.2% were exercised for cash at $11.50 per share, yielding aggregate proceeds of $104.5 million. The remaining 71,310 warrants were redeemed for $713. This is a routine post-IPO warrant redemption, not a special situation.
